provenance.source: model knowledge, training boundary around May 2026 — NOT human-verified
provenance.contract: Every row ships status='unverified' with next_review equal to last_verified, so it is stale on the day it loads. Both safety mechanisms therefore fire on day one: the catalogue badges the row in the UI, and any draft parameterised by it carries the first-page warning block. An operator promotes a row to status='open' only after checking every field against the funder's own current guidance, and sets next_review 90 days out at that point.
provenance.warning: Do not raise last_verified or set status='open' in this file. Verification is an act somebody performs, not a value somebody types.
